updateTo.name: Walkway 0.1.1
updateTo.notes:
Signed and notarized Walkway preview for Apple silicon Macs.

This release establishes the preview update channel. Versions 0.1.1 and 0.1.2 use the same tested application code; 0.1.2 verifies delivery of a newer signed version.

Download the ZIP, extract Walkway.app, and move it to Applications. Keep your existing app until you have finished active work. Existing unsigned previews need this one-time manual installation. Signed builds can use **Walkway → Check for Update**.

SHA256SUMS is included for download verification. These are early previews; broader compatibility and workflow testing is still ongoing.

updateTo.name: Walkway 0.1.4
updateTo.notes:
Signed and notarized Walkway preview for Apple silicon Macs.

Adds a compact update indicator below the conversation: checking, downloading, ready, waiting to restart, and failure states. A thin animated line shows activity during checks and downloads. Failed updates offer Retry; ready updates offer Review.

The native updater does not expose a download percentage. This release uses an indeterminate indicator without an estimated percentage or time remaining.

Download the ZIP and replace Walkway.app after finishing active work. Signed installations can use **Walkway → Check for Update**. SHA256SUMS is included.

updateTo.name: Walkway 0.1.10
updateTo.notes:
# Walkway preview

This preview improves everyday desktop work, with local terminal sessions and more control over updates and the macOS menu.

## Highlights

- Open terminal sessions alongside conversations, switch between them without stopping the shell, and keep conversation drafts in place.
- Configure supported macOS menu-bar actions through conversation.
- Choose how update restarts are handled and see clearer update progress.

## Fixes and refinements

- Improvements to workspace startup, customization refresh and local installation handling.
- Refinements to session controls, document previews and screenshot feedback.

## Preview limitations

- This download is for Apple Silicon Macs.
- Terminal sessions end when their vault window closes or Walkway quits; shell processes are not restored after restarting the app.
- Existing vault customizations remain local and may differ from the bundled interface.

updateTo.name: Walkway 0.1.13
updateTo.notes:
# Walkway preview

This preview adds clearer oversight of ongoing work and makes conversations, reviews and shared tables easier to use.

## Highlights

- A vault Companion provides work summaries, configurable check-ins, Run Now and Pause/Resume controls. Review and edit proposals to create, reopen, archive or organize sessions before applying them.
- Follow activity in the Notifications feed with source links and response controls. Optional macOS alerts remain separate from in-app activity.
- Work with shared vault tables using inline cell editing, typed columns, saved views and table artifacts alongside conversations.
- Connect a private Telegram bot to a vault, with explicit pairing, durable message receipts and distinct incoming-message presentation.
- Read compact task replies with links back to their source tasks.
- Review changes with source-linked diffs and change-impact details, and collect feedback on images offered together before sending it.

## Fixes and refinements

- Load long conversation histories in bounded pages while preserving saved messages and keeping live approvals separate.
- Keep long pasted text compact and open its full content for reading; display pasted conversations with speaker metadata.
- Improve session hierarchy, activity indicators, suggested replies, file pickers, artifact tabs and screenshot feedback.
- Improve saved-draft handling during frontend refresh and recovery of returning workspaces.

## Preview limitations

- This download is for Apple Silicon Macs.
- Companion recommendations require review before session lifecycle changes are applied; recommendations do not approve new work.
- History paging requires a compatible bundled runtime. An individual item exceeding the supported size reports an error without deleting saved history.
- Terminal sessions end when their vault window closes or Walkway quits; shell processes are not restored after restarting the app.
- Existing vault customizations and pinned backends remain local and may differ from the bundled interface; publishing this version does not activate them.
- Live Telegram photo/reply feedback, typing/reaction observations and complete response timing remain under evaluation.
- Compact task-reply presentation requires the matching backend. Native acceptance in existing customized workspaces remains pending.
- Native alert visibility and the updated Stay Awake behavior still require live host acceptance.
